title: Volume Mapping System
tagline: Estimates cargo volume the moment it's loaded.

meta.title: Volume Mapping System | Foxtroit AI
meta.description: Estimates cargo volume the moment it's loaded.

blocks.title: The Problem
blocks.content: Estimating how much cargo space is actually being used is normally a manual guess, which leads to trucks running under- or over-utilized and driving costs up.

blocks.title: The Solution
blocks.content: 3D vision measures the cargo volume directly and reports it in real time, adaptable to irregular load shapes.

blocks.title: Outcome
blocks.content: Better space utilization per trip, and fewer trips overall.
